🇲🇽🛢️ SEMARNAT RULES OUT CAMPECHE "OIL SPILL" AFTER FISHERMEN'S ALERT

When Campeche fishermen reported an oil slick four nautical miles off Lerma, Mexico's environmental authorities moved the same day. Semarnat, Pemex, Profepa, the energy-safety agency ASEA and the Navy ran a physical inspection, and the Campeche Hydrocarbon Committee confirmed no presence of hydrocarbons on the coast. Alert raised July 5, verified and cleared by July 6.

🇲🇽🏭 GUANAJUATO'S EXPORTS TO ENGLAND JUMPED 194%

As Mexico faced England at the Azteca, Guanajuato was already winning off the pitch: exports to England surged 193.9% in Q1 to over $10.5 million — cars, auto parts, and Mexican condiments. 47 firms, 30,587 families employed. Silao alone up 374%.

🇲🇽🌎 MEXICO NAMES AMBASSADOR TO THE EU — DIVERSIFYING AWAY FROM TRUMP

Congress confirmed Esteban Moctezuma as Mexico's ambassador to the European Union, 28-8. "Europe represents a significant opportunity," he said — after Washington refused to renew the T-MEC for 16 years and imposed annual reviews instead. Mexico's answer to US pressure: new markets, not surrender.

🇲🇽🏭 "NO NERVOUSNESS ABOUT THE MEXICAN ECONOMY" — SHEINBAUM ON T-MEC

"There is no nervousness that something will happen with the Mexican economy," Sheinbaum said, confirming the T-MEC holds to 2036. She called Washington's new annual reviews US protectionism — not a threat — while pushing regional content up and dependence on foreign inputs down. The peso held near 17.5 to the dollar.

🇲🇽📚 145,000 KIDS GET FREE GLASSES — MEXICO SCREENED 10.8 MILLION STUDENTS

Mexico's "Vive Saludable, Vive Feliz" program screened 10.8 million primary students across 83,000 schools and just handed 145,000 of them free eyeglasses, with 1.5 million more pairs on the way — carried out by 700 brigades and 8,000 IMSS and Health specialists. Now permanent policy.

🇲🇽🇻🇪 MEXICO SAILS 707 TONS TO VENEZUELA WHILE WASHINGTON SANCTIONS

Two Mexican Navy ships sailed for Venezuela carrying 707.3 tons of food and supplies — earthquake relief for a country Washington chokes with sanctions. While the empire demands isolation, Sheinbaum's government answers with cargo holds full of víveres.

🚨🇲🇽 Britain listed 11 Mexican states as places to avoid — then sent its team and its fans to Mexico anyway. The UK Foreign Office World Cup advisory named Chihuahua, Sinaloa, Tamaulipas, Zacatecas, Guanajuato, Michoacán, Jalisco, Colima, Guerrero, Chiapas and Baja California, citing phone thefts and drink tampering. Meanwhile Mexico organizes fan zones, adds crowd-control screens, and hosts a Round of 16 match in the largest city in the hemisphere. "Es seguro visitar el país." — President Claudia Sheinbaum

🇲🇽⚽ Mexico hosts England at the Estadio Ciudad de México today — El Tri unbeaten in the tournament. Mexico reached the Round of 16 without conceding a goal, after beating Ecuador 2-0. Its last win over England came in 1985 — in this same city. Mexico is co-hosting the 2026 World Cup and staging knockout matches in its capital.

🇲🇽🌎 "It is safe to visit the country." Days before England play Mexico in Mexico City, the UK issued a World Cup travel alert covering 11 Mexican states. President Sheinbaum answered plainly: "Es seguro visitar el país; no tienen ningún problema." "It is safe to visit the country; you'll have no problem." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera, July 2, 2026 Mexico City is adding screens at fan zones to ease crowding after four people died in celebration crowds. The Round of 16 match is at the Estadio Ciudad de México.

🇲🇽💵 <u>MEXICO JUST TOOK 22% OF ALL FOREIGN INVESTMENT IN LATIN AMERICA</u>

While Trump talks the country down, capital votes with its feet: Mexico captured a record $23.591 billion in foreign direct investment in Q1 2026, up 10.4% year-on-year — 22% of all FDI flowing into Latin America, second only to Brazil, per El Financiero and Banxico figures. 2025 closed at a historic $40.871 billion; 2026 is tracking toward $48 billion. "México está abierto a las inversiones," Sheinbaum said — provided investors follow Mexico's rules.
